_note: Explicit thresholds for scripts/evaluate_detector_v2.py. Recorded here because the LSTM threshold artifact is missing from outputs/anomaly_detector (threshold.json was deleted in commit 49b006b), and because the dynamic thresholds stored in the artifacts were fit with smoothing='none' while configs/config.yaml requests EWMA for runtime. Passing them explicitly keeps the evaluation reproducible and stops it depending on a path or on silent defaults.
